fields.description: Selvara is a four bedroom villa neighbourhood within Grand Polo Club & Resort. Its shared pool terrace, gym, yoga pavilion and planted common areas complement homes arranged over three levels. The original Selvara collection has A and B layout families; later Selvara phases should be assessed using their own documents.
amenities: Wider estate polo fields, stables and clubhouse

overview: Selvara’s brochure puts shared outdoor spaces alongside everyday home life: a pool terrace, children’s play areas and paths through planted grounds. A retail promenade and the wider estate’s Green Core provide neighbourhood context. The interiors use muted tones with stone and timber imagery, but buyers should compare the material schedule and exact layout rather than choosing from a rendering alone.
research.locationNote: Selvara is within Grand Polo Club & Resort, near the masterplan’s central polo fields, stables and clubhouse. The developer map relates it to Al Maktoum International Airport, The Oasis and the wider Dubai road network. Access points, walking distances and travel times need a practical check.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s page advertises Selvara from AED 6.2 million. The figure does not establish remaining availability or a current offer for a selected villa; written unit pricing and terms are needed.
research.paymentNote: The launch plan consists of 10% on booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Dates below belong to that launch schedule, with some already passed. Current outstanding payments depend on the unit’s contract.
research.handoverNote: April 2029 is the launch payment sheet’s estimated construction-completion month, also reported by Property Finder. Confirm current progress and contractual handover separately.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: The launch fact sheet lists 237 four bedroom villas, with average built-up area of 3,802 sq ft and average plot area of 3,610 sq ft. These are collection averages, not unit-specific dimensions or current availability.

facts.label: Area and layout basis
facts.value: Reviewed suites range from 2,806.04 to 2,913.68 sq ft; totals include terrace/balcony and carport space. Plans show a ground-floor guest bedroom, three bedrooms above and a second-floor roof lounge. The extra service space is labelled ‘linen room’.

facts.label: Published finish direction
facts.value: The branded material board shows neutral paint, wood-tone and pale joinery, flooring, a wardrobe carcass finish, mirror and metal finishes, and a veined countertop/backsplash sample. Product grades, brands and final installation scope are not specified there.
